title: German E-Invoice Legacy Bridge for SMEs
reason: Pain and regulatory urgency are real, but the proposed wedge is already directly served by multiple vendors offering legacy-ERP integration, API conversion, validation, and AI-assisted mapping/PDF-to-e-invoice conversion. No sufficiently differentiated second-order problem was identified.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic XRechnung/ZUGFeRD conversion or legacy-system adapter
reopen_if: fresh evidence reveals a narrower unsolved workflow with repeated willingness-to-pay signals beyond format conversion/integration

title: Generic EU AI Act compliance automation for SMEs
reason: Regulatory urgency and confusion are real, but the category is crowded with classifiers, documentation generators and compliance trackers; one builder publicly reported commercial failure despite a working automated compliance engine. Trust/distribution strongly favor legal/compliance incumbents.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic AI Act risk classifier, compliance pack generator, AI inventory, or badge for SMEs
reopen_if: fresh evidence reveals a narrow vertical workflow tied to an operational system where compliance is generated as a by-product and users already pay for the underlying workflow

title: Automated freight detention/accessorial recovery for small carriers
reason: Carrier pain and lost revenue are strong, but multiple 2026 vendors already offer ELD/TMS-connected automatic detention detection, evidence capture, claim filing, billing and recovery, including Tollup, Bastion Recovery, Calcutiv/FleetOptos and DockChron.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic detention-pay recovery, ELD geofence evidence capture, or accessorial revenue recovery
reopen_if: a narrower claim type, broker/customer exception, or underserved geography repeatedly appears that current recovery platforms do not support

title: COI / Vendor Insurance Expiry Tracking
reason: Property managers still report spreadsheet-based expiry tracking and missed renewals, but property-management vendor portals and dedicated COI products already automate document collection, reminders, validation and audit trails.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic COI tracker, expiry reminder system, or vendor certificate portal
reopen_if: a narrow segment repeatedly shows that current PM/vendor platforms are too heavy or fail a specific insurance-compliance workflow and will pay for a lighter alternative

title: Accounting / Tax Client Document Chasing
reason: Repeated reminders and incomplete client files create real labor cost, but TaxDome, Canopy, Financial Cents, ShareFile and specialist workflow tools already address generic document requests, reminders and client portals.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic automated client document reminders, tax organizer chasing, or accounting request portal
reopen_if: a specific tax/accounting process has repeated evidence of failed incumbent workflows plus paid demand for a narrow concierge pilot

title: CBAM Supplier Emissions Data Collection
reason: CBAM creates mandatory supplier-data work, but multiple dedicated products already provide supplier portals, automated requests/reminders, emissions collection, validation, audit packs and even managed supplier chasing.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic CBAM supplier portal, emissions-data chase, or declaration-prep workflow
reopen_if: a sector/importer segment repeatedly identifies a second-order supplier exception or data-quality workflow that current CBAM platforms demonstrably fail

title: Generic EUDR Traceability / Compliance Workflow
reason: Traceability, supplier onboarding, geolocation and due-diligence work are real, but specialist platforms and free/open-source tooling already cover the generic workflow.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic EUDR supplier portal, geolocation collector, DDS workflow, or audit trail
reopen_if: new evidence identifies a narrow commodity/SME workflow where available tooling is structurally unusable and users already spend money on manual workarounds

title: Generic PPWR Packaging Compliance Software
reason: PPWR creates current packaging-data and declaration work, but several PPWR-native products already sell supplier collection, declarations of conformity, substance data and compliance workflows at low self-serve prices.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic PPWR data collector, DoC generator, supplier portal, or packaging compliance dashboard
reopen_if: a product/packaging segment repeatedly exposes an operational exception not covered by current PPWR-native tools

title: Freight Invoice Audit for SMB Shippers / 3PLs
reason: Overcharges, accessorials and invoice-vs-quote mismatches are real, but exact upload-based, automated and human-reviewed freight audit products already serve SMB shippers, brokers and 3PLs.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic freight invoice checker, LTL audit, rate-con/POD/invoice matching, or accessorial audit
reopen_if: a specific carrier, shipment mode, contract structure or exception class repeatedly escapes existing audit products and carries measurable recovered value

title: Multi-Marketplace Settlement Reconciliation
reason: One strong mid-market ecommerce signal showed very high manual workload and lost expansion opportunity, but there was insufficient independent evidence for the precise wedge and custom marketplace reconciliation is already directly offered by products such as Cointab alongside broader ecommerce accounting tools.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic Amazon/Walmart/Shopify/marketplace settlement reconciliation or arbitrary CSV matching
reopen_if: 3+ independent $5m-$50m brands identify the same unsupported marketplace or fee logic and at least one will pay for a manual monthly reconciliation pilot

title: PE/VC Portfolio Company Reporting Normalization
reason: Small funds clearly spend recurring time collecting heterogeneous portco data, but Standard Metrics, Rundit and other portfolio-monitoring platforms already cover collection, normalization, source traceability, Excel sync and reporting.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic email/PDF/Excel portfolio data extraction, KPI normalization, or monthly PE reporting dashboard
reopen_if: 3+ small funds explicitly reject incumbents for price, onboarding friction, format coverage or setup burden and will pay for a narrower managed email-in/Excel-out service

title: Nonprofit Post-Award Grant Tracking
reason: Nonprofits repeatedly use spreadsheets and manual communication for grant deadlines, deliverables and reports, but low-cost products already cover post-award deadlines, tasks, documents, reimbursements and audit readiness.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic grant deadline tracker, post-award task manager, reporting reminder system, or grant document hub
reopen_if: a narrow grant type or organizational segment repeatedly shows an expensive exception workflow that current grant trackers do not handle

title: Customer-Specific PPAP / Product Specification Documentation
reason: Manufacturers face real customer-specific documentation burden, but specialist tools already automate PPAP packages, customer-specific requirement checklists and custom specification-sheet generation.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic PPAP pack automation, customer-format spec sheets, or manufacturing quality document generator
reopen_if: a specific OEM/customer requirement or legacy-system handoff repeatedly remains manual despite existing PPAP/spec tooling

title: Cyber Resilience Act Reporting / Compliance Workflow
reason: The 11 September 2026 reporting deadline creates a strong forcing trigger, but generic CRA compliance, SBOM/vulnerability monitoring and reporting orchestration are already offered by multiple product-security and CRA-specific vendors. No repeated user evidence yet identifies a surviving second-order workflow.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic CRA compliance cockpit, SBOM/vulnerability monitor, 24h/72h reporting reminder, or SRP reporting assistant
reopen_if: manufacturers repeatedly report that existing security/SBOM tools fail a specific evidence-ownership, legal-security handoff, SRP submission, or incident deadline workflow and will pay for that layer
